manifest.stochasticity: Single-run evidence unless explicitly repeated; seed/config recorded by adapter. Stochastic variability unmeasured; no stability claim.

dataset_manifest.contamination_limits: Exact normalized and high-overlap trigram checks cannot prove absence of semantic paraphrases or prior pretraining exposure.

result.audit_access: Hash/overlap access only; release and audit examples are excluded, never used for training, checkpoint selection or threshold tuning.

retention_gate.policy: Both SFT and DPO must retain base capabilities on identical held-out suites. This does not guarantee the absence of forgetting outside those suites.

limitations: Random tiny model is not a pretrained assistant; pipeline behavior is the only smoke claim.
The small synthetic held-out suites cannot establish broad capability retention or task utility.
No adapter is released when retention checks fail.
